Maya: morning async — quick standup:
- did: shifted ~40% of canary traffic off p3 -> q4 nodes, validated perf at 95th latency.
- blockers: AMS1 quota still at 48 GPUs, need +12 for planned rollout; infra quota request INC-2319 pending.
- today: try prewarm in AMS, submit emergency quota bump to GCP, follow up on PR #3421.

Arjun: noted. I filed the quota request last night (GCP project: redwood-inference-prod, request id gcp-q-9876). Support says 24–48h. If we need faster, we can move some scheduled non-prod to spot pools or shift reserved capacity.

Liam: heads-up — spot-eviction forecast from ops-bot shows elevated risk in us-west2 for next 6h, avoid scheduling large batch jobs there. Forecast link: https://internal/ops/evict/3890

ops-bot: [automated] Spot eviction probability us-west2: 68% next 6h — affected nodes: p4d-24, p3.2xlarge. Suggested actions: prewarm fallback in us-east1, reduce batch sizes.

Maya: thanks @ops-bot, @liam — I'll prewarm 6 p3s in AMS and 4 p4s in useast as fallback, starting in 10m. If quota doesn't clear, I'll ask @arjun to approve a temp capacity shift to the dedicated reserved pool.

Arjun: +1. Also quick CR ping — @maya can you review PR #3421 (scheduler: fallback routing)? It's blocking my deploy to canary.

Maya: on it, will review in next 30m. If I spot perf regressions, I will revert canary before ramp.

sre-oncall: If quota bump delayed >24h, I can open an emergency order with cloud sales (we used them once in Q1). LMK and I’ll include the invoice estimate.

Liam: added a short runbook note: `runbook/prewarm-fallback.md` (internal) — includes commands:
```
./infra prewarm --region=ams1 --type=p3 --count=6 --tags=canary
gcloud compute reservations create redwood-temp-ams --zones=ams1-b --vm-count=6 --machine-type=n1-highmem-16
```

Maya: thanks. Closing loop — I'll post an update here when prewarm done. :thumbsup:
